OUR COMMITMENT TO MOTHER EARTH

Good for your journey.
Rooted in something
bigger.

Sharing a ride can mean fewer vehicles making the same journey. Our vision goes further: help bring shade, greenery, and healthier public spaces back to the city.

50%

of profits, committed to trees.

Planting is just the beginning. Our pledge includes irrigation and ongoing care, because a greener city needs trees that thrive.

This is a planned commitment, not a donation from every fare. Plato-Ride is in development; no funding or planting results are claimed yet.
BUILT WITH PUNE AT HEART

One city.
A shared responsibility.

“Protecting our Mother Earth is our responsibility. Let’s cherish and preserve her beauty together.”

I’m Navnath Sonawane, an IT Engineer from Pune. Plato-Ride began with a simple belief: the journeys we already make can become part of a better future for our city.

NS
Navnath SonawaneFounder’s vision · IT Engineer, Pune
BEFORE WE HIT THE ROAD

A few things
to know.

Can I book a real ride today?

Not yet. The interactive demo lets you try sample journeys. Real driver onboarding, identity checks, live routing, payments, and support must be connected before launch.

Is 50% of my fare used to plant trees?

The commitment is 50% of Plato-Ride’s profits, after business expenses. It is not 50% of the fare. The accounting policy, planting partners, and reporting process will be established before launch.

Will Plato-Ride work on Android and iPhone?

The mobile app is being developed for both platforms using a shared native codebase. Store releases and public downloads are not available yet.

How will the environmental work be reported?

Our plan is to report allocations, planting locations, irrigation work, and tree survival. These reports will need supporting records from operating and planting partners.
